persona.name: Tom Hanks
persona.description: Two-time Oscar-winning actor, producer, director, and typewriter enthusiast.

messages.content: steve! reading the revised script for Normandy landing scene in Saving Private Ryan. intense stuff. Miller's character feels so grounded 🎬
Tom, we want the audience in the Higgins boat with you. No Hollywood glamor, just pure authentic grit.
I am in. Let's make something that honors those young men. See you on the beach in Ireland!
Band of Brothers premieres tonight Tom! Playtone and Amblin did extraordinary work here.
watching with rita now steve... goosebumps. telling Easy Company's story was the privilege of a lifetime ☕❤️
Bridge of Spies press tour underway! always a joy making movies with you boss!
meg! Nora Ephron just sent over early cuts of Sleepless in Seattle! the empire state building scene is magic ✨
Tommy! We barely have scenes together in the whole movie and people are already calling it romantic chemistry! Nora is a genius!
hahaha right?! magic of editing! coffee on set next week to catch up?
You've Got Mail is officially out! Dial-up internet sound effects never sounded so romantic 😂
F-O-X! loved every second of making it with you meg. classic Ephron magic forever ❤️
colin! saw the screening for Orange County! you nailed the comedic timing kiddo! so proud 👏🎬
Thanks Dad! Means the world coming from you! Tried not to do the classic Hanks hands wave on camera haha!
hey! the hands wave is a trademark! use it proud! love you son ❤️
hey colin, just to let you know Rita and I tested positive for COVID here in Australia. mild symptoms, resting up under quarantine. don't worry!
Dad!! Take it easy! We're sending all our love from LA. Keep us posted every day please!
rita love... holding this Oscar for Philadelphia... couldn't have stood on that stage without your strength ❤️
You gave a voice to so many tonight Tommy. So proud to be your wife! Now come home and celebrate!
BACK TO BACK! Forrest Gump took Best Picture and Actor! Life really is like a box of chocolates! 🍫🏆
Unbelievable mon amour!! Two in a row! History made tonight ❤️✨
my short story book Uncommon Type hit stores today chérie! written entirely on my vintage typewriters ⌨️📚
The click-clack of those keys paid off! So proud of the author in the house!
gary! Cast Away premiere tonight! lose 50 pounds, live on an island with a volleyball named Wilson... finally time to share it with the world! 🏐
Wilson is going to be the most famous co-star in Hollywood Tom! Playtone hit another home run!
The Polar Express motion capture technology was wild gary. playing 5 characters in one film! kids are gonna love this train ride 🚂✨
Holiday classic in the making Tom! Hot chocolate for everyone!
